name: Divisibility MOD (Congruence) Properties
description:
MOD (Congruence) Properties

1. a ≡ b (mod m)
   ⇒ a and b give same remainder when divided by m

2. If a ≡ b (mod m)
   ⇒ a + c ≡ b + c (mod m)

3. If a ≡ b (mod m)
   ⇒ a − c ≡ b − c (mod m)

4. If a ≡ b (mod m)
   ⇒ ac ≡ bc (mod m)

5. If a ≡ b (mod m)
   ⇒ aⁿ ≡ bⁿ (mod m)

6. (a + b) mod m
   = [(a mod m) + (b mod m)] mod m

7. (a − b) mod m
   = [(a mod m) − (b mod m)] mod m

8. (ab) mod m
   = [(a mod m)(b mod m)] mod m

9. If a ≡ −1 (mod m)
   ⇒ a² ≡ 1 (mod m)
   ⇒ a⁴ ≡ 1 (mod m)
   Even power ⇒ 1
   Odd power ⇒ −1
